tests.name: Basic behavior
tests.code:
import torch
x = torch.randn(2, 8)
weight = torch.ones(8)
out = {fn}(x, weight)
assert out.shape == x.shape, f'Shape mismatch: {out.shape}'
rms = torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
ref = x / rms * weight
assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-5), 'Value mismatch'

tests.name: With learned weight
tests.code:
import torch
x = torch.randn(4, 16)
weight = torch.randn(16)
out = {fn}(x, weight)
rms = torch.sqrt(x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
ref = x / rms * weight
assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-5), 'Value mismatch with non-trivial weight'
